coverage_proposal.eligible_anchor_missing: Keep native ERA5 with zero fine residual and explicit coverage flag; do not reuse current sea-level terrain correction.
coverage_proposal.antarctica: WorldClim absent south of60S. CHELSA supplies tested Antarctic values but has not been station-validated there.

independent_land_mask.source: Natural Earth10m land v5.1.1 union minor-islands v4.1.0
independent_land_mask.licence: public domain; derivative publication allowed; attribution optional
independent_land_mask.advertised_download: 3.12MB land plus307.55KB minor islands; no download made
independent_land_mask.rasterization: Union both polygon layers onto chosen temperature grid; retain partial-land coverage instead of inheriting0.25degree land mask.
independent_land_mask.limitation: 10m means1:10million map scale, not10metres. Minor islands are absent from main land layer. Northern Russia/southern Chile coastline accuracy and polar minor-island completeness are acknowledged source limitations.

caveats: 5x5 windows measure local smoothing, not globally aligned coarse cells.
Representative tile sizes are empirical examples, not a global storage total.
CHELSA point checks do not establish complete worldwide land-mask coverage.
WorldClim missing-cache tiles are untested, not absent data.
Grayscale16 PNGs encode one anchor; opaque RGB8 PNGs encode both high/low for one month.
Packed RGB PNGs need raw-channel decoding with color conversion disabled.
CHELSA has values at ocean coordinates; its valid-data mask is not a land mask.
